method: Leave one PDB entry out. Place every same-role, same-sequence candidate from other entries into the held-out upstream base frame. Compare its predicted downstream frame and atom coordinates with the held-out reference.
candidate_selection: No candidate is selected or ranked by held-out atom coordinates. Metrics are reported for every cross-entry candidate; target downstream frames are explicit oracle pose constraints from the held-out structures.
